statement: Steam C6 source-backed claims steam-c6-feature-kernel-exchange, steam-c6-feature-registration, steam-c6-feature-kernel-lizard, steam-c6-feature-sdl-lizard and steam-c6-feature-imu now document consumer-specific open/settings commands with synthetic request and structural reply examples. Actual device GET data, physical SET acknowledgement and stateful persistence, undocumented feature2 on direct wired hardware, timeout behavior in a live host, and descriptor-dependent lengths remain unverified.

applicability.scope: Residual live/physical roundtrip gap after C6 host code source review and synthetic GET/SET frames. Reply-serial-empty and reply-attributes-empty are deliberately made-up structural fallback examples, not real device values; physical ACK bytes: No evidence.
